verdict.rationale: Floot documents an official remote MCP server that works with Cursor, VS Code, Zed, Claude, ChatGPT and other remote-MCP clients, and it runs on the user's existing AI subscription. Its documented tool surface includes get_logs, query_database/execute_sql/pull_database_schema, create_checkpoint and generate_image, and a probe confirmed the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as documented.
